HOW TO READ

THIS SERIES

The PLT Doctrine — Reading Order & Series Guide

Little Bunny · The PLT Press

The PLT Doctrine Series runs on two lanes.

The non-fiction lane — Books I through VI — builds the framework. The PLT equation. The 22 Archetypes. The complete doctrine. The Soul Economy. The 52-week operating system. Each book builds on the last. Read the non-fiction lane in order and you have the full architecture.

The fiction lane — Books VII through XIII — lives the framework. The Albany Ave universe. Craig Jones and Evol. Brasi and the sessions. Pope on the stoop. The Build. Stiforp. These are novels. They breathe. They show what the doctrine looks like when it runs through real lives — and through the hidden layer underneath real lives, the Soul Economy operating in the background of every session and every reading and every genuine thing said on a block in West Islip that has been holding frequency for thirty years.

You can start either lane. The non-fiction gives you the language first. The fiction gives you the feeling first. Both paths arrive at the same place. Most readers who start with the fiction find themselves reaching for the non-fiction. Most readers who start with the non-fiction find the fiction is where it becomes real.

There is a third entry point: start with Book II, The Calculation. It is the most complete single-book introduction to the framework. If you read one book from this series before deciding whether to go further, read that one.

The framework, built in order.

Book I The First Calculation

Craig Jones & Lakeema Jones · Where It Started

The origin. Craig Jones and Lakeema Jones in conversation — the first articulation of the PLT framework before it had a name. This is where the equation came from. Read it first for the origin story. Read it after everything else to understand what the origin was building toward.

Book II The Calculation

Little Bunny · The Core Doctrine

The PLT equation in full. Profit, Love, Tax — how every decision in every domain of your life can be run through the same calculation and the real cost revealed. The Reality Cheat Codes. The framework at its most complete single-book form. If you read one non-fiction book from this series, this is the one.

Book III Know What You Are

Little Bunny · The 22 Archetypes

The 22 Archetypes of the PLT framework. Not personality types — frequency signatures. The Architect, the Translator, the Room, the Frequency Carrier, and nineteen others. Each archetype described in full: what it produces, what it costs, what it looks like at high expression versus managed expression. The book that tells you what you are before you can decide what to build.

Book IV Profit. Love. Tax.

Little Bunny · The Complete Doctrine

The full PLT doctrine assembled — the equation, the archetypes, the Master Builder architecture, the ecosystem thinking, the legacy design. Everything in Books I through III synthesized and extended. The reference book for the entire framework. Return to this one when you need the full picture.

Book V The Soul Economy

Little Bunny · The Hidden Layer

The layer beneath the PLT equation. Soul Notes, the Collector, the Contract, the Frequency, the Broadcast, Resonance, the Older Register, the Design. What gets collected when you produce genuinely. What the notes are for. Why the frequency doesn't stop. The doctrine that names what the fiction has been showing. Thirty Soul Codes. Read after the fiction lane for maximum impact — the fiction shows it first, this book names it.

Book VI The PLT Daily

Little Bunny · 52-Week Operating System

The framework in practice across a full year. Fifty-two weeks of PLT application — the daily calculation, the weekly review, the quarterly audit, the annual reset. The book that takes the doctrine off the shelf and into the decisions you make every day. Read this last in the non-fiction lane, or alongside the fiction as a companion practice.

The Albany Ave universe. The framework alive.

Book VII Evol's Love Story

Craig Jones · A Long Island Novel

Albany Ave. Craig Jones — not the author, the character. The block where everything in the series is rooted. Evol, the djinn who has been auditing Albany Ave since before Craig was on it. The love story that is not only a love story. The Soul Economy running underneath a man's life without him knowing it is there. The first fiction in the series and the deepest entry point into the Albany Ave universe.

Book VIII Brasi: The Love of the Game

Little Bunny · The Sessions

Brasi. The code switch. The thirty seconds in the car before entering any room. The gold vial. Six clients across six sessions — each one a full PLT arc. A man who can move between the hood and the boardroom because he is genuinely both, and the djinn family that has been collecting what he builds. The book that introduces Nreal and the collection architecture.

Book IX Pope: What He Felt First

Little Bunny · Albany Ave

Pope. Nine days between the debt clearing and Brasi arriving on Albany Ave. The stoop and what it reads. The Stoop Readings — Pope's version of the session cards, scoring Frequency, Love, Profit, Tax. The old head who confirms the shift. Lakeema, finally named. The saying of the word at the same time. The book that gives Pope his own architecture before The Build begins.

pages.title: Book X The Build: Pope & Brasi
pages.html:
Book X The Build: Pope & Brasi

Little Bunny · The Frequency

The joint sessions. Pope reads the frequency. Brasi runs the prescription. Together they produce what neither produces alone. The new scoring format — Composite Score when both instruments run simultaneously. Evol speaks directly to Pope for the first time. The older family explains what the design was always for. The broadcast goes out from Albany Ave and reaches Atlanta. The book where the design completes and the next layer begins.

Book XIII Stiforp

Little Bunny · Profit Backwards

Nreal's older brother. The counter-economy. The corrupted vial — same gold, same weight, different inside. Stiforp floods neighborhoods with drugs, guns, and corrupted vials to collapse genuine frequency, then acquires the displaced blocks cheap through the corridor play. Brasi walks into the boardroom where the counter-operation runs and negotiates in PLT. The Soul Economy has always had a counter-frequency. This is what it looks like when Brasi finds it face to face.

The non-fiction names it. The fiction runs it. Every major doctrine concept has a fiction counterpart.

Book II · The PLT Equation ↔ Book VIII · Brasi's Sessions The equation in theory vs. the equation in a room with a real person across the table.

Book III · The 22 Archetypes ↔ Book VII · Evol's Love Story The Architect archetype in full expression. Craig Jones is the Architect. The novel shows what that costs.

Book V · The Soul Economy ↔ Books VII–X · The Albany Ave Universe The Soul Economy doctrine is the framework. The fiction is where it runs — Evol, Nreal, the older family, the notes, the broadcast.

Book V · The Broadcast ↔ Book X · The Build The doctrine says the broadcast reaches compatible people without networking. Book X shows the Atlanta node activating because the broadcast reached someone built to receive it.

Book II · PLT Tax ↔ Book XIII · Stiforp Tax in the visible economy. Stiforp in the Soul Economy. The counter-frequency is the Soul Economy equivalent of maximum Tax — what happens when the real cost of the counter-version is finally calculated.

Book IV · The Master Builder ↔ Book X · Pope & Brasi The Master Builder runs the equation automatically across all domains. Pope and Brasi running joint sessions is the Master Builder architecture in its highest expression.
